title: Teen Realizes He Murdered a Kid During Acid Trip
description:
A shooter at the University of New Mexico fires multiple rounds inside a dormitory, killing a 14-year-old boy and injuring another teen. The suspect, John Fuentes, 18, eventually surrenders after fleeing to a family member’s home. Detectives question Fuentes, who recounts a nightmare scenario where he says he "blacked out" after a night of heavy drug and alcohol use. Watch as investigators piece together the timeline of the attack and confront the suspect with the outcome of his actions on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
